ops.entry: WHEN proposing fail-closed handling for damaged state DO check which supported repair operations still work on that same state and weigh losing the last repair route against the evidence recovery would discard — a safe refusal can leave operators with only more destructive manual repair.
ops.why: G-15 protects evidence and P-11 traces enforcement consumers; neither tests repair availability. This is more actionable than G-05's fix-cost heuristic, which can cut reachability analysis short.

originals.original: WHEN a reachability argument requires proving no trigger exists (e.g. across arbitrary shell) DO weigh it against fix cost — an unprovable negative paired with a one-line fix means the reachability investigation is the wrong expenditure; grade on blast radius and auditability instead.
